name: Special and Rescheduled Meeting Public Notice
description: Publication and posting of notice of special or rescheduled meetings (waived for actual emergencies).
deadline: at least twenty-four (24) hours prior to the meeting
quote: Notice of all special meetings shall be given by publication and posting of notice at least twenty-four (24) hours prior to the time of the meeting, except that such notice shall be waived when a special meeting is called to deal with an actual emergency involving a clear and present danger to life or property.
